fields.Name: CRD-12 - Reader
fields.Description: Verify the reading queue on the server transport with the fixture recognizer and reader (answers keyed by standard code) and real isolated providers: an upload is read into one extraction per bound standard whose offsets slice the stored text to the excerpt, a second drain adds nothing, a replacement supersedes the old extractions, a quote absent from the document is discarded and counted, a document telling the reader to mark the standard met confirms nothing, an unbound requirement reads 0 passages for 0 standards, a reader that throws leaves the upload accepted and the document Failed, a crashed Running claim is reclaimed only once stale, Could Not Run is requeued by the boot sweep and by RequeueReading, two concurrent commits on one subject both land and a forced rollback leaves the other's extractions, and a scan's recognized text is stored once.
